_comment: Release gate A15: every download program a source knows is in the catalogue or excluded with a reason. The catalogue is the program types of src/lib/programs/catalog.ts under the names these sources spell them (source-names.json, held to catalog.ts by catalog.test.ts). Sonarr and Radarr list the download programs they drive, one folder each. pyLoad and JDownloader appear in neither list.

excluded.Blackhole: A watch folder Sonarr and Radarr drop .torrent and .nzb files into, not a program with an interface to read.
excluded.DownloadStation: The download package of a Synology NAS, reached through the NAS's own web API; not one of the programs dl-manager drives.
excluded.Flood: A web interface in front of rTorrent, qBittorrent, Transmission or Deluge, not a download program of its own - dl-manager talks to the program behind it.
excluded.FreeboxDownload: The download service built into the Freebox router of the French provider Free; not one of the programs dl-manager drives.
excluded.Hadouken: A headless BitTorrent client whose repository has had no change since 2020-08-30; not one of the programs dl-manager drives.
excluded.NzbVortex: A commercial Usenet client for macOS; not one of the programs dl-manager drives.
excluded.Pneumatic: Writes .strm files for the Kodi add-on Pneumatic, not a program with an interface to read.
excluded.RQBit: A BitTorrent client written in Rust with an HTTP API; not one of the programs dl-manager drives.
excluded.Tribler: A BitTorrent client with anonymous downloading over its own onion network; not one of the programs dl-manager drives.
excluded.Vuze: A Java BitTorrent client, formerly Azureus; not one of the programs dl-manager drives.
excluded.rTorrent: A terminal BitTorrent client reached over XML-RPC through SCGI; not one of the programs dl-manager drives.
excluded.uTorrent: A closed-source BitTorrent client for Windows and macOS; not one of the programs dl-manager drives.
